For **training**, the reward-model (RM) dataset had **6,623 labeler-written prompts** and **26,584 customer (API) prompts** (Table 6, p. 33). That adds up to 33,207 training prompts. This matches the "33k training prompts (from the API and labeler-written)" figure on p. 6 and the RM train count of 33,207 in Table 9 (p. 33).

The **validation** split had 3,488 labeler prompts and 14,399 customer prompts (Table 6, p. 33).

Each prompt came with 4 to 9 ranked outputs, and the model was trained on all pairwise comparisons among them. So the number of ranked pairs used in training is about an order of magnitude larger than the number of prompts (p. 33).
